Title: Radar plausibility validation
Description: Radar returns must be validated against a camera-confirmed range-rate envelope before being trusted for AEB braking decisions; an implausible return must fall back to camera-only detection and never suppress AEB entirely

Title: TTC re-evaluation after lock loss
Description: AEB must correctly re-evaluate time-to-collision and resume tracking after a transient radar lock loss rather than remain in a stale pre-loss state

Title: Pre-collision warning latency
Description: Audible and visual pre-collision driver warning must fire within 300ms of AEB threat detection

Title: Graceful degradation under sensor overload
Description: AEB perception pipeline must degrade to camera-only and warn the driver rather than hang when radar data volume exceeds processing capacity

Title: Re-arm after full stop
Description: AEB must re-arm within 30 seconds after a full stop-and-release cycle rather than remain latched inactive

Title: TTC recalculation on changing deceleration
Description: Time-to-collision must recalculate correctly when the target vehicle's deceleration rate changes mid-approach rather than using a stale estimate

Title: AEB sensitivity configuration
Description: Driver must be able to configure AEB sensitivity (Early/Standard/Late) via the HMI settings menu

Title: Manual-override event logging
Description: Each driver manual-override event during an AEB intervention must be written to the safety event log exactly once and rejected on duplicate

Title: Warning accessibility redundancy
Description: AEB warning must be perceivable through both visual and audible channels for drivers with a hearing or vision limitation

Title: EDR activation logging
Description: Every AEB activation (full or partial brake intervention) must be written to the vehicle's event data recorder (EDR) / safety audit log
